import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianKernelSection
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianCandidateBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CurveQuotientSupport
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocallyFreeRank

/-!
# Finite support of the universal Grassmannian candidate

For a line bundle on a proper smooth geometrically integral curve, a
Grassmannian quotient of rank strictly smaller than the section rank
reconstructs a quotient with finite support over every locally noetherian
test scheme. The canonical candidate commutes with base change, and the
rank gap supplies a nonzero killed section on each residue-field fibre.
In particular this applies to the universal Grassmannian quotient itself.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits
open AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The candidate reconstructed from a Grassmannian quotient has finite
relative support when its quotient rank is smaller than the section rank. -/
theorem isFinite_candidateSupport_of_rank_lt
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) r)
    (hdr : d < r) {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian T.left]
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) d T) :
    IsFinite (Modules.schematicSupportι (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)) ≫
      pullback.snd C.hom T.hom) := by
  let p := pullback.snd C.hom T.hom
  let F := cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent C.hom L
  haveI : IsProper p := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback C.hom T.hom) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := candidateQuotient_isFinitePresentation L q
  letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1) :=
    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  apply Modules.isFinite_schematicSupport_of_fiber_genericPoint_avoidance p F
  intro t
  let Tt : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    Over.mk (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ T.hom)
  let ψ : Tt ⟶ T := Over.homMk (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t) rfl
  let qt := pullbackAlong ψ q
  let e : (pullback C.hom Tt.hom : Scheme.{u}) ≅ p.fiber t :=
    (quotBaseSquare C.hom ψ).isoPullback
  haveI : IsIntegral (pullback C.hom Tt.hom) := IsIntegral.of_isIso e.inv
  haveI : IsAffine Tt.left :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsAffine (Spec (T.left.residueField t)))
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Tt.left :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocallyNoetherian (Spec (T.left.residueField t)))
  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd C.hom Tt.hom) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback C.hom Tt.hom) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.snd C.hom Tt.hom)
  haveI : (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L qt)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    candidateQuotient_isFinitePresentation L qt
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom Tt.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom Tt.hom) L
  haveI : Epi qt.q := qt.epi
  have hK : ¬ IsZero (kernel qt.q) :=
    Modules.not_isZero_kernel_of_locallyFree_rank_ne
      (Modules.pullback_isLocallyFreeOfRank Tt.hom hV) qt.locFree
      (Nat.ne_of_gt hdr) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (T.left.residueField t)) qt.q
  have hgeneric := genericPoint_not_mem_candidateSupport L hL qt hK
  haveI : (p.fiberModule t F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.pullback_isFinitePresentation (p.fiberι t) F inferInstance
  have he : e.hom ≫ p.fiberι t = quotBaseMap C.hom ψ :=
    (quotBaseSquare C.hom ψ).isoPullback_hom_fst
  let E : (Modules.pullback e.hom).obj (p.fiberModule t F) ≅
      cokernel (kernelEvaluation L qt) :=
    (Modules.pullbackComp e.hom (p.fiberι t)).app F ≪≫
      (Modules.pullbackCongr he).app F ≪≫ candidatePullbackIso L q ψ
  rw [← Modules.annihilator_eq_of_iso_support E,
    Modules.annihilator_pullback_support_eq_preimage e.hom (p.fiberModule t F)] at hgeneric
  intro h
  apply hgeneric
  change e.hom (genericPoint (pullback C.hom Tt.hom : Scheme.{u})) ∈
    (Modules.annihilator (p.fiberModule t F)).support
  rw [genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion e.hom]
  exact h

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian

/-- The actual universal Grassmannian candidate has finite schematic support
over the Grassmannian, under the strict section-rank inequality. -/
theorem isFinite_universalCandidateSupport
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d < r) :
    IsFinite (Modules.schematicSupportι
        (cokernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
          (universalQuotient hV hd (Nat.le_of_lt hdr)))) ≫
      pullback.snd C.hom (representingScheme hV hd (Nat.le_of_lt hdr)).hom) :=
  LocallyFreeQuotient.isFinite_candidateSupport_of_rank_lt C L hL hV hdr
    (universalQuotient hV hd (Nat.le_of_lt hdr))

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian
